changes_made: Added import for FilterConfig and apply_list_filters from apps.core.list_utils
Refactored quick_print view function to use centralized apply_list_filters utility
Replaced manual filter application with declarative FilterConfig objects
Changed from manual queryset slicing (bins[:100]) to pagination via apply_list_filters
Simplified context data passing by using unpacking of filter_values
file_insights.complexity_reduction: Manual filter logic (25 lines) replaced with declarative configuration approach

patterns_discovered.description: Moving from inline filter logic to reusable apply_list_filters utility pattern
patterns_discovered.benefit: Consistency across views, maintainability, reduced code duplication

patterns_discovered.description: Using FilterConfig objects to define filters with param_name, filter_type, and filter_kwargs
patterns_discovered.implementation_details: Supports search, field-based, and likely other filter types with placeholder value substitution

patterns_discovered.description: Moving from manual result limiting to page_obj returned by apply_list_filters
patterns_discovered.benefit: Enables proper pagination support in templates without extra code

patterns_discovered.description: Using **result['filter_values'] to dynamically add filter values to template context
patterns_discovered.benefit: Automatically provides selected filter values to templates without explicit passing

gotchas_discovered.description: Original code had compound ordering ('warehouse__code', 'code'), refactored code uses default_ordering='code' only
gotchas_discovered.impact: Potential change in displayed order - results may not group by warehouse anymore
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Verify this ordering change doesn't affect user experience; may need to update default_ordering or add multi-field ordering support

gotchas_discovered.description: Variables 'search', 'selected_warehouse', 'selected_status' removed from context, replaced with filter_values unpacking
gotchas_discovered.impact: Template must be updated to use new context structure if these variables are referenced
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Verify template compatibility; ensure filter_values provides same data structure

gotchas_discovered.description: Page size set to 100 in apply_list_filters call, matching previous manual slicing
gotchas_discovered.impact: No flexibility for users to change results per page without code modification
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Consider making page_size configurable or allowing request parameter override

gotchas_discovered.description: Original context included 'total_bins': bins.count(), not explicitly replaced
gotchas_discovered.impact: Template may lose access to total count if it was used for UI display
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Verify apply_list_filters result includes total count info or update template to use paginator data

approach_outcome.summary: Successfully refactored quick_print view to use apply_list_filters utility, consolidating filter logic into declarative FilterConfig objects
key_achievements: Removed 25 lines of manual filter application code
concerns: Ordering behavior changed - verify warehouse grouping is not required
Context variable names changed - template compatibility needs verification
Total count handling may differ - paginator.count should be verified

recommendations.recommendation: Run template rendering tests for labels/quick_print.html to ensure filter_values unpacking provides correct variable structure
recommendations.rationale: Context variable names changed significantly; template compatibility is critical

recommendations.recommendation: Compare original and refactored ordering behavior; confirm warehouse grouping is not affected
recommendations.rationale: Ordering reduced from compound to single field; may impact UX

recommendations.recommendation: Verify apply_list_filters result structure includes total count; update template if count display was present
recommendations.rationale: total_bins context variable was removed; need to confirm paginator provides equivalent data

recommendations.recommendation: Document FilterConfig usage pattern and expected filter_values structure for template developers
recommendations.rationale: New filter pattern is less explicit; documentation helps prevent future template integration issues

recommendations.recommendation: Consider making page_size configurable via request parameter or settings
recommendations.rationale: Current hardcoded page_size=100 limits flexibility for future requirements
